data.name: Sathishkumar
data.gender_notes: Sathishkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: God's Abode, God's Abode of Prosperity
data.long_meaning: Sathishkumar is a compound name, derived from two Tamil words. Sathi means 'God' and Kumar means 'God's Abode'. The second part of the name, Kumar, can also be translated as 'God's Abode of Prosperity'. The name Sathishkumar carries the meaning “God's Abode, God's Abode of Prosperity” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Tamil, Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sathishkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode, god's abode of prosperity and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sathishkumar is a sacred name that signifies the presence of God in one's life. It is believed that those named Sathishkumar are blessed with the divine grace and protection of the gods. The name is also associated with prosperity and abundance.
data.etymology: Sathishkumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Abode, God's Abode of Prosperity.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sathishkumar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
